title: Require Civ7 Service Contract Envelope Ownership
forbids: detached or borrowed complete request and response schemas in Civ7 service contract leaves
why: A service procedure contract is the sole authority for its complete request and response envelopes. Inline roots make that ownership visible while still allowing private composable schema parts within the contract file.
remediate: Inline the complete standard(Type.*(...)) request and response roots directly in the procedure builder. Keep only genuinely composable nested schema parts as private local values.
message: Civ7 service contract leaves must own their complete request and response envelopes inline.
